$comment: The single source of truth for which backend responses we have actually observed.
Both scripts/record-contract.mjs and scripts/check-contract.mjs read this file,
and scripts/coverage.mjs diffs it against docs/api/swagger.snapshot.json to answer
'what do we not know yet?'. Adding an endpoint is an edit here, not to a script.
op       METHOD + path, exactly as keyed in the OpenAPI document.
sample   Query string used when recording. Prefer a large pageSize: nullable
fields only reveal themselves across a wide enough sample.
schema   Named export from lib/api/schemas/catalog.ts. Omit (null) when the
shape has been recorded but not yet modelled — coverage counts only
itemsAt  Dotted path to the array whose per-field nullability we summarise.
auth     true → recorded only when CONTRACT_TOKEN is set.
An invented schema is worse than none: it alarms on the truth. Leave schema null
until a real response has been observed.

endpoints.label: cart
endpoints.$why: Only ever observed empty, so the item shape is genuinely unknown. Modelling it now would be a guess.

endpoints.label: cart-related
endpoints.$why: A bare array — no envelope, and items are neither Product nor MaterialSummary.

endpoints.label: admin-products-create
endpoints.$why: Recorded by scripts/record-mutations.mjs. Returns ApiEnvelope<Product> — the same 41 fields as GET /Products.

endpoints.label: admin-products-update
endpoints.$why: Recorded. ApiEnvelope<Product>. NOTE: UpdateProductDto omits brandType/productType and adds isActive.

endpoints.label: admin-products-delete
endpoints.$why: Recorded. data is a bare boolean, not a Product.

endpoints.label: admin-products-bulk
endpoints.$why: Recorded. Created rows arrive under data.createdProducts, NOT data[] like every other create on this surface.

endpoints.label: admin-product-image
endpoints.$why: Multipart, field `file`. Returns ApiEnvelope<ProductImageDto>. Recorded by scripts/explore-image-upload.mjs; now in the refreshed snapshot.

endpoints.label: ai-styles
endpoints.$why: A bare array of { id, name } — no envelope. Public. The `style` field on GenerateImageDto/GenerateVideoDto takes the id.

endpoints.label: portfolio
endpoints.$why: The public before/after showcase behind /project. Enveloped, but the pagination block is the un-enveloped style — data.{items,totalCount,page,pageSize,totalPages,hasMore}, not Paged's pageNumber/hasNextPage. Each item carries beforeImages[], afterImages[], referenceImages[] and thumbnailUrl.
